# FG-EDGE-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `manifest_rejects_unsafe_blob_path` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: エッジのリリースのマニフェストの形が正しくありません。
- en: The edge release manifest is not well-formed.
- id: Manifes rilis edge tidak berbentuk benar.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 21 §5.2 (ADR-0041 §2): a signed release file (`{manifest, digest, key_id, signature}`) or its manifest did not parse or broke a rule, so its digest could not be computed. `reason`: `too_large` (> 4 MiB), `json_syntax` (with `line <n>`; an unknown or duplicate key is refused, nothing ignored), `schema_version` (only 1), `release_id` / `project` / `version` / `os` (empty, too long or characters outside the allowed set), `source_sha` (40 or 64 lower-case hex), `sequence` (0), `created_at` (not an RFC 3339 instant), `arch`, `max_install_seconds` (1..=7200), `health_soak_seconds` (0..=86400), `ci_pipeline_id` (0), `no_payloads`, `payload_kind` (only `files` / `oci-image` / `agent`), `duplicate_kind`, `agent_not_alone`, `agent_blob_count` (an `agent` payload is exactly one blob), `no_blobs`, `too_many_blobs` (> 4096 per payload), `blob_sha256` (not 64 lower-case hex), `blob_size` (0 or > 8 GiB), `blob_path` (the artifact path rules of FG-EDGE-0001), `duplicate_blob_path` (also two paths that differ only by letter case), `blob_path_conflict` (one path is a directory of another), `secret_like_path`, `digest_syntax` (the envelope's digest is not `sha256:<64 hex>`), `key_id` (empty or over 64 characters). The server builds manifests from linted definitions (E4), so on a device or in gstn this means the file is not one the server signed — treat it like FG-EDGE-0004.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`gstn edge release verify --release <file> --json` lists the problem with `reason` and `subject` (the field or blob path). Compare the file with the one the server serves for the release (E5: `GET /api/v1/edge/desired`).

## 対処 (fix)

Use the release file exactly as the server served it. A hand-edited or truncated file never verifies; fetch it again.
